review.reviewBody: Real tasty pizza. I just wish the dough was cooked a little more so it had less flop. Will def be ordering again.

(Merchant Only) The best in town hands down. I order from y'all every week and tell my friends about you guys. It feels and looks like East coast pizza! 
Tonight was weirdly thick/wet on the outer ring of the pizza (which is the best part) which I automatically noticed and tasted. I appreciate the guy who picked up the phone tonight when I called. I felt bad criticizing the pizza when I asked if they changed the recipe. I only called because i was worried my favorite pizza place was changing and not to be rude!  He was amazing with customer service and a really great guy. Still loyal to Hoboken/riders no matter what  thanks!

If you want freezer food that tastes awful is expensive and takes 2+ hours to make, order from here! They claim to be the same as hobken and that is entirely false. The mozzarella sticks, baked ziti, subs and pizza all come from the freezer section of costco. The food took over an hour extra from the projected time. Probably because they were defrosting it from thrckstfo pack. Save   money and time and order from anywhere else.
I paid $32 for a pizza the least you can do is clean your ovens and not burn the pizza. completely black at the bottom and tastes like charcoal.
Crust SO thin the entire thing cant  be eating by the slice...theres better
